decisions.reason: A formwork profile system with several models and its own web page is a core consumable line close to the established offer, and it is likely to stay.
Automated flow control for the concrete distributor fits the firm's push toward automation and becomes part of its integrated plant offering.
Shuttering magnets are a standard recurring-revenue item for precast plants, and a multi-model line is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
The magnetic formwork strips have their own web page and several models, which signals an established product the firm intends to keep.
This magnetic formwork component with a dedicated page complements the formwork range at low ongoing cost.
This component is only mentioned on the website and may be merged into the range later, but it is cheap to keep as an accessory within the formwork portfolio.
